description.value: Glo Restaurant + Lounge sits on the Selkirk Waterway in Victoria, just minutes from the Galloping Goose Regional Trail, making it a natural stop for cyclists on one of BC's most popular multi-use paths. The 180-degree wrap-around patio features heaters, blankets, and umbrellas for year-round outdoor dining with unobstructed waterway views. Executive Chef Andrew Fawcett's seasonally changing menu draws on local and global inspiration, with strong vegetarian and gluten-friendly representation throughout.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: wave (5 spaces) at 44m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Glo Restaurant & Lounge is a full-service sit-down restaurant at 104–2940 Jutland Rd on the Selkirk Waterway, explicitly described as 'just minutes from the Galloping Goose Trail,' making it directly relevant to cycling tourists. The menu pages consistently label items with 'gf' (gluten friendly) and 'veg' (vegetarian) markers throughout, confirming dietary accommodations. No bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, device charging, or other cyclist-specific infrastructure is mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields remain null.
